The '''virus bomb''' or '''viral bomb''' was created and utilized by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] to spread his modified [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] back into the galaxy.

==Description==
[[File:VirusBombRoom-BSV.png|thumb|left|250px|A chamber filled with armed virus bombs]]
Round and easily portable, the virus bombs were gray spheres which held canisters of Vindi's [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. They had a red circle of light when activated, and a hole for the Blue Shadow Virus canisters.

==History==
Vindi manufactured many of these bombs to release his air-potent Blue Shadow Virus back into the galaxy. When his plot was discovered, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka]] led a [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid]] on his lab. After Vindi attempted to escape, he remotely activated the bombs, intending on releasing the plague. Fortunately, [[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|clone ordnance specialists]], who were bomb disposal troopers managed to deactivate all the bombs in time.

Later, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]] and the [[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|Bomb squad]] discovered that a virus canister was missing from one of the bombs. Vindi's servant droid [[LEP-86C8/Legends|LEP-86C8]], having possession of the missing canister, sneaked back into the bomb room and placed the canister back into a bomb. Before the clone troopers were able to stop it, the droid set the bomb off and the virus was released into the lab, infecting Ahsoka, [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and the clone troopers, and later Padmé as well. Anakin and Obi-Wan managed to find a cure for the virus in time which was a [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa root]] from [[Iego/Legends|Iego]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Frozen Citadel]]'', there were a few similar virus bombs that contained the deadly [[Rooze Disease]].
